title: GRB 261108D: DECam optical detection of candidate afterglow
version: 2026-11-10. GCN Circular 46211, observers' notice archived at NASA.
lineage: GCN Circular 46211, observers' notice archived at NASA.

passages.note: The observers report 9 November 2026 imaging with DECam on the CTIO 4 m Blanco telescope under programme 2026B-398365. The claim retained here is that the instrument was used, regardless of the eventual astrophysical identification.
